content.text:
The **next NBA game** appears to be **Spurs @ Knicks — Monday, June 8, 2026, 8:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM PT at Madison Square Garden**. 

Best places to get tickets:

1. **Ticketmaster** — the official ticket marketplace for the NBA/Knicks. The listing shown is **“NBA Finals: San Antonio Spurs at New York Knicks Game 3”** at Madison Square Garden on **June 8**. ([ticketmaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=new%2Byork%2Bknicks&utm_source=openai))  
2. **New York Knicks official ticket page** — usually routes to Ticketmaster for official primary/resale tickets. Ticketmaster is listed as the Official Ticket Marketplace of the New York Knicks. ([ticketmaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/new-york-knicks-tickets/artist/805988?cmp=NYK_FebGames_232301&venueId=483329&utm_source=openai))  
3. **Madison Square Garden box office / MSG site** — useful if you’re local or need accessibility help; MSG also points buyers to Ticketmaster for online ordering. ([ticketmaster.ca](https://www.ticketmaster.ca/madison-square-garden-tickets-new-york/venue/483329?utm_source=openai))  
4. **Secondary marketplaces** like SeatGeek, StubHub, or Vivid Seats — but for a Finals game, watch out for very high prices and make sure tickets are mobile-transfer verified.

If you tell me your **city/team** or your budget, I can help find the best option for the specific game you want.
